paragraphs: In Pesachim 57a Abba Shaul ben Batnit said in the name of Abba Yosef ben Chanin: “Woe is me because of the house of Baitos … woe is me because of the house of Chanin” — they were high priests, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Pesachim 57a paragraph names Abba Shaul ben Batnit reporting Abba Yosef ben Chanin and includes the house of Chanin among the priestly houses criticized. The heading and abbreviated quotation preserve Hyman’s scope; no additional identification with other Chanins is inferred.
